_telemetryGovernance_ws33_note: WS3.3 (live evidence: 1.57M AppTraces/48h, requests=0). Host.Results=Information RESTORES per-invocation request telemetry (Warning suppressed it -> the requests=0 visibility gap). Adaptive sampling ON (5 items/sec steady-state) bounds the trace flood (Durable replays re-log host lines); Request+Exception are NEVER sampled (the health/DoD signals). The high-volume replay diagnostics (CTX-INPUT/RAW-INPUT dumps) are additionally gated behind XDRLR_DEBUG_DURABLE.
_managedDependency_iter15_note: NO managedDependency block + NO bundled Az modules. iter#14 bundled Az.Accounts+Az.KeyVault but the Az.KeyVault.private assembly failed to bind on Legion (cascade-failing all module loads). iter#15 removed the Az dependency entirely: KV secrets, DCE token, and Storage token are all acquired via the managed-identity REST endpoint (IDENTITY_ENDPOINT). The function-app.zip contains ONLY src/ (~100KB · zero PSGallery modules).
